pattern: On value and contrast, generated cards give themselves away by how they stage the light. They put a bright glow or sunburst directly behind the hero, so the hero reads as a darker silhouette (strongly negative lightness_gap). They throw a spotlight on a low-key, dark-cornered set (low lightness_mean, high vignette). And they scatter many small clipped-white specular glints across surfaces. Real cards stay high-key with an even, broad background, keep the hero in light and middle values with soft roll-off, and keep the darkest accents small and placed within the object.
